core_obligations: Reduce to an affine base (proof lines 11998): the question is local on X, so one may assume X affine, which makes the strata manageably finite.

Pass to a common refinement (proof lines 11999-12001): since two partitions into constructible locally closed strata admit a common refinement of the same type and pullbacks commute with tensor product, one may work on the members of a single partition on which both sheaves are locally constant.

Apply the locally constant case (proof lines 12001-12002): on each stratum the tensor product of two locally constant sheaves is locally constant by the cited same-chapter result, so the tensor product is constructible with respect to the same partition.
proof_roadmap: Work affine without loss of generality.
Refine the two constructibility partitions to a common one.
On each stratum both sheaves are locally constant, hence so is their tensor product.
The common partition therefore witnesses constructibility of the tensor product.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that the tensor product of two constructible sheaves of Lambda-modules on X_etale is constructible, for Lambda Noetherian (statement lines 11990-11995). The proof is a standard refinement argument: reduce to an affine base, refine the two partitions giving constructibility to a common partition of the same type, and use that on each stratum both sheaves are locally constant, so their tensor product is locally constant by the cited same-chapter statement, pulled back along the stratum inclusion (proof lines 11998-12002). The content is the bookkeeping of the common refinement, which is where the notion of constructibility is used. The claim is H2: one refinement reduction plus one known local statement.
